head.t: Alcon wins £591k direct-award maintenance contract for Moorfields' ophthalmic surgical fleet
head.x: Moorfields Eye Hospital NHS Foundation Trust has directly awarded Alcon Eye Care UK Ltd a contract worth £591,000 excluding VAT (£709,200 including VAT) to maintain its fleet of Alcon ophthalmic surgical systems, including the NGENUITY 3D Visualization System, PUREPOINT Laser, CENTURION Vision…
